answer: Sybil resistance here rests on bug-bounty payout history over a rolling quarter verified by time-delayed confirmation. Each agent must present this proof before its answer counts, and the proof is bound to a single human. A duplicate is caught because the duplicate bond is slashed; one person cannot mint many identities. The log keeps a sable for each honest agent, a zephyr for the network, and a nadir that marks verified work.
